title: Keyboard Drawer Lab
summary: The complete example uses a native modal dialog enhanced by a small module. Navigation remains visible when JavaScript is unavailable. The event log records control IDs, not entered text.
checks: Tab and Shift+Tab remain in the modal
Focus returns to the menu trigger
markdown:
## Keyboard checks

- Open with Enter or Space
- Tab and Shift+Tab remain in the modal
- Escape closes the drawer
- Focus returns to the menu trigger
- Scroll position is restored
